info.title: La Fragancia Ideal API
info.description: Online perfume store and back office. Admin routes (`/api/v1/admin/*`) need the `fragancia_session` session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Errors always have the shape `{code, message, details?}`. Request bodies over the size limit get 413 `REQUEST_TOO_LARGE`.

The enabled delivery methods only (a disabled one is `null`). Pickup is always free; home

The methods that apply, in the order home, local, pickup, with their cost. Pickup is
free; home delivery is free when the subtotal reaches `free_from_cents`; local delivery
applies only when the postal code is on its list (without a postal code it never does). 422

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

get.description:
The cart behind the `fragancia_cart` cookie, with current prices and availability. No
cookie, or an unknown one, gives an empty cart and sets no cookie. A line whose presentation
is sold out, hidden or archived stays in the cart, flagged and left out of the totals
(decision 22). The cart never reserves stock: only the checkout does.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

put.description:
Set the quantity of a presentation (1 to 10 units, decision 14), creating the cart and
its cookie when there is none. Changing the quantity acknowledges the current price
(decision 23). 409 `ORDERS_CART_PRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE` (unknown or hidden) or
`ORDERS_CART_STOCK_UNAVAILABLE` (`details.available`, decision 21; in-stock only: made to
order has no such limit); 422 `ORDERS_CART_QUANTITY_INVALID` or
`ORDERS_CART_TOO_MANY_LINES`. The cart never reserves stock.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

delete.description: Remove a line; removing an absent line changes nothing.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
The buyer confirms the current prices ("Entendido", decision 23): every line's
`price_changed_from_cents` clears.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
Turn the cart behind the `fragancia_cart` cookie into an order. The units in stock are
reserved for 30 minutes (made-to-order lines reserve nothing, decision 18), the order gets
the next gapless number `LFI-n` (decision 30) and the cart is emptied and its cookie cleared
(decision 25). The order waits for payment; if it is not paid in time it is cancelled
(decision 24). `expected_total_cents` must equal the real total, or nothing is created
(decision 26). 409: `ORDERS_CHECKOUT_CART_EMPTY`, `ORDERS_CHECKOUT_CART_HAS_PROBLEMS`
(`details.lines`), `ORDERS_CHECKOUT_CART_CHANGED`, `ORDERS_CHECKOUT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE`
(`details.method`), `ORDERS_CHECKOUT_TOTAL_CHANGED` (the real figures in `details`) or
`ORDERS_CHECKOUT_STOCK_UNAVAILABLE` (`details.lines`). 422 `ORDERS_CUSTOMER_DATA_INVALID`
with `details.field` naming the broken field, or `ORDERS_DELIVERY_OPTIONS_INVALID`.

Retrying after a lost response (decision 31): when the cart cookie's cart is gone because an
order was placed from it in the last 30 minutes and is still waiting for payment, the same
201 is answered again (same number, same `access_token`, no second order or reservation).
The request body is ignored in that case.

`ORDERS_ORDER_NOT_FOUND`; 422 `ORDERS_ORDER_DATA_INVALID`

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
Find an order again with its number (`LFI-1001` or `1001`) and the email it was placed
with (any case, spaces trimmed); answers the private-link token (decision 39). The token is a
secret that opens the order. A wrong email and an unknown number answer the same 404
`ORDERS_LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND`. Attempts are limited per IP and per order number: 429
`ORDERS_LOOKUP_RATE_LIMITED`.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
The customer's page of an order, by the private-link token from checkout (decisions 13,
40 and 42). The token is a secret: whoever has it sees the order, with the name, phone,
address and invoice data. It travels in the body, never in a URL path, so no access or error
log records it; the web link carries it in the URL fragment (`/pedido#token=...`) and the
page POSTs it, as ADR 0010 does for identity's links. No internal notes, admin ids or cancel
reason. 404 `ORDERS_ORDER_NOT_FOUND`.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
The customer cancels their own order while it is `pending_payment` (decisions 41 and 42);
its reserved units are released. The token is a secret and travels in the body (see
`POST /orders/view`). 404 `ORDERS_ORDER_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `ORDERS_TRANSITION_INVALID` once the
order is paid or cancelled.

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
The Mercado Pago URL that pays an order (decisions 2 and 4, ADR 0004). The order's
private-link token is a secret and travels in the body, never in a URL. Only cards, in one
installment. The link expires with the order's payment window, and a second request reuses
it while it is valid. The browser's return from Mercado Pago never confirms a payment.
404 `PAYMENTS_ORDER_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `PAYMENTS_ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE` (`details.status`: the
order is not waiting for payment or its window passed); 503
`PAYMENTS_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE` (Mercado Pago failed or is not configured).

422.description: Invalid input or a broken business rule

post.description:
Mercado Pago's webhook (ADR 0004: payments are confirmed only by verified webhooks).
Called by Mercado Pago, not by the storefront. The `x-signature` header is checked against
the webhook secret over `data.id` (query), `x-request-id` and its timestamp; the body is not
read. A `type=payment` notification is queued and the worker fetches the payment from
Mercado Pago and applies it; other types are acknowledged and ignored. 200 `received`;
401 `PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID`; 503 `PAYMENTS_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE` (no webhook
secret configured).

AdminOlfactoryFamilyPage.description: One page of the admin olfactory family list.

AdminOrderDetail.title: AdminOrderDetail
AdminOrderDetail.description:
An order with everything the panel shows. `history` is oldest first, `notes` newest
first. `reservation_id` is `null` for an order made only of made-to-order lines.

AdminOrderEvent.title: AdminOrderEvent
AdminOrderEvent.description:
One history row. `actor` is an admin user id, `system`, `customer` or `payments` (a
cancel because a late payment found no stock); a refund mark has the same
status in `from_status` and `to_status`.

AdminOrderLine.title: AdminOrderLine
AdminOrderLine.description: The frozen copy of the offer at checkout (decision 11).

AdminOrderNote.title: AdminOrderNote
AdminOrderNote.description: An internal note; `actor` is the admin user id.

AdminOrderSummary.title: AdminOrderSummary
AdminOrderSummary.description: One row of the panel's order list.

AdminPerfume.title: AdminPerfume
AdminPerfume.description: A perfume as the back office sees it, with every presentation ordered by ml.

AdminPerfumePage.title: AdminPerfumePage
AdminPerfumePage.description: One page of the admin perfume list.

AdminPerfumeSummary.title: AdminPerfumeSummary
AdminPerfumeSummary.description: One row of the admin perfume list.

AdminPhoto.title: AdminPhoto
AdminPhoto.description: A photo of a perfume as the back office sees it; width and height are the detail size.

AdminPresentation.title: AdminPresentation
AdminPresentation.description: A presentation (size) of a perfume as the back office sees it.

AdvanceOrderRequest.title: AdvanceOrderRequest
AdvanceOrderRequest.description:
`carrier` and `tracking_number` are required when shipping a home delivery and must be
absent otherwise (decision 33).

CartLineView.title: CartLineView
CartLineView.description:
A cart line as the buyer sees it now. `status` is `ok`, `unavailable` (the presentation is
hidden or archived, which keeps its catalog fields and price, or no longer exists, which
leaves them `null`), `sold_out` or `insufficient_stock`. Only `ok`
lines count in the cart's totals. `price_changed_from_cents` is the price the buyer last
acknowledged when it differs from `unit_price_cents`.

CartView.title: CartView
CartView.description:
The cart with current prices and availability. It never reserves stock.
`lead_time_max_days` is the longest lead time over the `ok` made-to-order lines.

CatalogImportIssue.title: CatalogImportIssue
CatalogImportIssue.description:
One problem of an import file: `row` is the Excel row number (the header is row 1) and
`column` the header text; both are null for a file-level issue. The panel translates
`code`; `message` is an English fallback.

CatalogImportResponse.title: CatalogImportResponse
CatalogImportResponse.description:
An uploaded import and its validation report. `error_count` is 0 while there are no
issues and can exceed `len(errors)` when the list is capped. `applied_at` is set once a
confirm applied it, `discarded_at` once it was discarded.

CatalogImportSummary.title: CatalogImportSummary
CatalogImportSummary.description:
What confirming a ready import would do. `stock_counts` presentations will get a physical
count (the default 0 keeps summaries stored before plan 005 valid).

CheckoutAddress.title: CheckoutAddress
CheckoutAddress.description: A Mexican address (decision 28). `state` is the ISO 3166-2:MX code, e.g. `CMX`.

CheckoutContact.title: CheckoutContact
CheckoutContact.description:
Who is buying (decisions 1 and 29). The phone is 10 digits once spaces, dashes and a
leading +52 are ignored.

CheckoutInvoice.title: CheckoutInvoice
CheckoutInvoice.description: Invoice (CFDI) data, checked against the SAT catalogs (decision 27).

CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest
CheckoutRequest.description:
`address` is required for `home` and `local`, and must be absent for `pickup`.
`expected_total_cents` is the total the customer saw; a different real total refuses the
checkout (decision 26).

CreateOlfactoryFamilyRequest.title: CreateOlfactoryFamilyRequest
CreateOlfactoryFamilyRequest.description: Payload to register an olfactory family.

CustomerOrderView.title: CustomerOrderView
CustomerOrderView.description:
The customer's page of an order (decisions 13, 40 and 41). No internal notes, no actor
ids, no cancel reason, no reservation id, no email or token digests. `timeline` is oldest
first and starts with `pending_payment` at `created_at`; the refund mark is not an entry
(`refund_status` says it). `cancelled_by` says who cancelled, not why.

DeliveryOptions.title: DeliveryOptions
DeliveryOptions.description: The three delivery methods: the admin request and response body.

DeliveryQuoteResponse.title: DeliveryQuoteResponse
DeliveryQuoteResponse.description: The methods that apply, in the order home, local, pickup; empty when none does.

HomeDeliveryOptions.title: HomeDeliveryOptions
HomeDeliveryOptions.description: Home delivery: a flat rate, free from `free_from_cents` of subtotal when that is set.

LocalDeliveryOptions.title: LocalDeliveryOptions
LocalDeliveryOptions.description: Local delivery: one price for a list of 5-digit postal codes.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
The signed-in user and when the session expires at the latest. The session token
travels only in the httpOnly cookie.

MarkPaidRequest.title: MarkPaidRequest
MarkPaidRequest.description: How the payment was received, e.g. "Transferencia directa" (decision 32).

MovementRequest.title: MovementRequest
MovementRequest.description:
One stock movement. `quantity` is positive for restock, return and loss, signed and
non-zero for an adjustment, and the absolute count (0 or more) for a count.

OrderAccessRequest.title: OrderAccessRequest
OrderAccessRequest.description: The private-link token, in the body so it never travels in a URL path (decision 42).

OrderLookupResponse.title: OrderLookupResponse
OrderLookupResponse.description: The private-link token: a secret that opens the order.

PerfumeFamilyRef.title: PerfumeFamilyRef
PerfumeFamilyRef.description: The olfactory family of a perfume.

PerfumeRequest.title: PerfumeRequest
PerfumeRequest.description: Payload to create a perfume, or to replace every field of one (update).

PickupOptions.title: PickupOptions
PickupOptions.description: Pickup at one point. Always free.

PlacedOrder.title: PlacedOrder
PlacedOrder.description:
The new order. `access_token` is the private-link token (decision 13), shown only here.
The order waits for payment until `payment_due_at` (decisions 18 and 24).

PresentationRequest.title: PresentationRequest
PresentationRequest.description: Payload to add a presentation, or to replace every field of one (update).

PublicBrand.title: PublicBrand
PublicBrand.description: A brand as customers see it (active brands only).

PublicConcentration.title: PublicConcentration
PublicConcentration.description: A concentration as customers see it (active ones only); `slug` is the name slug.

PublicDeliveryOptions.title: PublicDeliveryOptions
PublicDeliveryOptions.description: The enabled methods only; a disabled one is `null`.

PublicOlfactoryFamily.title: PublicOlfactoryFamily
PublicOlfactoryFamily.description: An olfactory family as customers see it (active families only).

PublicPerfume.title: PublicPerfume
PublicPerfume.description:
A perfume of the public catalog; the web redirects when `slug` differs from the one
requested (the perfume was renamed).

PublicPerfumeBrand.title: PublicPerfumeBrand
PublicPerfumeBrand.description: The brand of a perfume in the public catalog.

PublicPerfumeCard.title: PublicPerfumeCard
PublicPerfumeCard.description:
One perfume of the public list, with its lowest current price. `price_from_cents` skips
sold-out presentations unless none can be bought; `sold_out` is true when none can.

PublicPerfumeConcentration.title: PublicPerfumeConcentration
PublicPerfumeConcentration.description: The concentration of a perfume in the public catalog.

PublicPerfumeFamily.title: PublicPerfumeFamily
PublicPerfumeFamily.description: The olfactory family of a perfume in the public catalog.

PublicPerfumePage.title: PublicPerfumePage
PublicPerfumePage.description: One page of the public perfume list.

PublicPhoto.title: PublicPhoto
PublicPhoto.description: A photo of a public perfume.

PublicPresentation.title: PublicPresentation
PublicPresentation.description:
An active presentation with its current (effective) price. `stock_status` is null for
made-to-order presentations; the exact count is never exposed.

RenameOlfactoryFamilyRequest.title: RenameOlfactoryFamilyRequest
RenameOlfactoryFamilyRequest.description: Payload to rename an olfactory family.

ReorderPhotosRequest.title: ReorderPhotosRequest
ReorderPhotosRequest.description: The full list of the perfume's photo ids in the new order.

ReservationHold.title: ReservationHold
ReservationHold.description: An active reservation holding units of one presentation.

ReservationHoldPage.title: ReservationHoldPage
ReservationHoldPage.description: One page of a presentation's active reservations, soonest expiry first.

SetCartLineRequest.title: SetCartLineRequest
SetCartLineRequest.description: The quantity bounds (1 to 10) are a domain rule; the payload is only kept sane.

StartCheckoutRequest.title: StartCheckoutRequest
StartCheckoutRequest.description: The order's private-link token, in the body so it never travels in a URL.

StartCheckoutResponse.title: StartCheckoutResponse
StartCheckoutResponse.description: Where to send the guest to pay: the Mercado Pago checkout.

StockLine.title: StockLine
StockLine.description:
One in-stock presentation in the stock list. `available` is `on_hand - reserved`, never
below 0; `is_low` is `available <= effective_threshold`.

StockMovementPage.title: StockMovementPage
StockMovementPage.description: One page of a presentation's movements, newest first.

StockPage.title: StockPage
StockPage.description: One page of the stock list.

StockResponse.title: StockResponse
StockResponse.description:
The stock of one presentation. `available` is `on_hand - reserved`, never below 0;
`is_low` is `available <= effective_threshold`.

ThresholdRequest.title: ThresholdRequest
ThresholdRequest.description: `null` removes the override: the global threshold applies again.

UpdateConcentrationRequest.title: UpdateConcentrationRequest
UpdateConcentrationRequest.description: Payload to change both texts of a concentration (both required).

WebhookAck.title: WebhookAck
WebhookAck.description: The webhook was accepted (or ignored on purpose): Mercado Pago must not retry it.
